text: Appeal of Dangerous Dog Order issued June 04, 2026, Appeal DDRT2026-08

The Dangerous Dog Review Tribunal: 1. Confirmed the determination of a dangerous dog, and directed that the conditions of the Order remain in effect, and that the Tribunal forwarded the reasons for this decision to Sarah D'Amico and the Executive Director, Municipal Licensing and Standards on or before October 1, 2026.
